summary: @servicetitan/suppress-warnings 38.1.2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared purpose is suppressing React development warnings, but its package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js on the installer's host. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotated string-array obfuscation and hex-generated identifiers, unrelated to React-warning suppression. Fetching an alternate language runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload at npm install time is an install-time dropper pattern that mismatches the declared purpose and evades Node-only static scanners. The package publishes under the @servicetitan scope with a description referencing servicetitan/uikit, consistent with a namespace-impersonation lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
